name: libmd
description: Message digest library providing MD2, MD4, MD5, RIPEMD-160, SHA-1, SHA-2, and SHA-3 (SHAKE) functions commonly found on BSD systems, split out of libbsd to serve as a portable, standalone implementation for non-BSD systems.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
